Luka Dončić is the first player since Michael Jordan in 1988 to score 300+ points through his first eight games of the season. 

Dončić has scored 308 total points while shooting 49.5% from the field and 43.1% from three-point range.

Wembanyama also became the second-youngest player in NBA history to have 50+ points and 20+ rebounds in a game.

Five youngest players with 50+ points, 20+ rebounds in a game:
▪️Bob McAdoo, 22 years, 150 days
▪️Victor Wembanyama, 22 years, 304 days
▪️Anthony Davis, 22 years, 347 days
▪️Elvin Hayes, 22 years, 362 days
▪️Wilt Chamberlain, 23 years, 83 days
With last night's performance, Victor Wembanyama became just the fifth player in NBA history to record multiple 50-point games before turning 23 years old.
